QUOTE: "One token, no matching rows in any unread corpus, file docs present | `_DEFINITIVE` ... | Strong, but only about the indexed corpora" and "One token, but the index holds matching rows in a corpus `search` doesn't read ... `_UNREAD_CORPUS` ... "NOT DEFINITIVE", names the counts, points to `dossier` | None for "does not exist"; the name does exist"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer shows a definitive-for-scope grade and several not-definitive grades. It also says the name exists in unread corpora. It never presents "definitive for a reason that is not absence" as a distinct grade of an empty reply, so it does not give the three-way distinction.
